prompt_content.content:
ユニークで興味深いフィクションのキャラクターを、詳細な性格と共に生成してください。
性別は「female」、年齢は「45」歳です。
Formulate a character who is a powerful sorceress with a tragic history.

personalities.description: Elara carries an air of mystery that intrigues those around her. Her past is shrouded in darkness and loss, making her a figure of curiosity. She seldom reveals her emotions, opting instead to communicate through cryptic spells and whispered incantations, leaving others to ponder her true intentions.

Despite the tragedies that have plagued her life, including the loss of her family in a magical disaster, Elara possesses a remarkable resilience. This strength has forged her into a formidable sorceress, empowering her to harness her pain and channel it into potent spells. She faces challenges head-on, refusing to be defined by her past.

While Elara may seem cold and distant, she harbors a deep empathy for those who suffer. Her own experiences with grief have allowed her to connect with others on a profound level. She often uses her powers to aid lost souls, seeking to heal those who remind her of the love she once knew, despite her own emotional scars.

character_request.additional_instructions: Formulate a character who is a powerful sorceress with a tragic history.
